text:
Ana: hey team, new hire here. trying to get my first PR to pass CI but it's failing both Buildkite and GH Actions. who do I ping for repo/app perms? :wave:

Priy: welcome! quick ask: what's the error in Buildkite? usually it's the Buildkite GitHub App or a missing deploy key.

Ana: Buildkite log: 
error: install_buildkite_github_app: pipeline cannot access repository (403)

Ana: GH Action shows: 
Secrets are not available to this workflow.

ci-bot: Note: Organization policy "Require approval for workflows from forks" is enabled for this repo.

Marco: ok looks like two things: Buildkite app not installed and the workflow is blocked by env protections or fork restrictions. Are you working from a fork or branch in the repo?

Ana: I opened a PR from a branch in-repo. Repo is private: github.com/redwood-inference/infra-templates.

Priy: If the PR is from a branch, secrets should be available unless the environment requires reviewers. Check Settings -> Environments for any protections. I'll request the Buildkite app be granted access to infra-templates now.

Marco: also check runner labels. If GH Action uses self-hosted labels and there isn't a matching runner the job will fail waiting. Our onboarding workflow uses ubuntu-latest by default so that usually works.

Priy: Buildkite app install requested. Ana, can you try re-running the GH Action after I approve the workflow for this PR?

Ana: did that, GH Action passed after approval. Buildkite still fails with git-lfs error: 

fatal: smudge "git-lfs smudge -- %f" returned 128

Marco: agents need git-lfs installed. I'll add a quick step to the pipeline to apt-get install git-lfs on linux agents and requeue.

ci-bot: Build #78 queued on group: general

Ana: build passed after the git-lfs fix. thanks all! any docs I should read for onboarding CI bits?

Priy: we have a short doc in the onboarding folder: docs/onboarding/ci.md. i'll DM you the link and schedule a 15m CI walkthrough. welcome aboard :)
